mapper.select: SELECT code, name_zh, name_en, category, digits, contract_size, unit, base_ccy, quote_ccy, max_leverage, min_lots, max_lots, lot_step, fee_rate, maintenance_margin_rate, markup, swap_long, swap_short, hot = 1 AS hot, open_paused = 1 AS open_paused, sort_order FROM market_symbol WHERE enabled = 1 ORDER BY sort_order, code
SELECT symbol, day_of_week, open_minute, close_minute FROM market_session
SELECT symbol, trade_date FROM market_holiday WHERE trade_date >= #{since}
